snippet.title: Crescent Break DEMO Trailer
snippet.description:
New DEMO coming out on June 8th, 2026!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4297720/Crescent_Break/

Crescent Break is a roguelike mixes NES-era robot hero goodness with indie classics. The game features permadeath, procedurally generated levels, and randomized abilities. The pieces of robots that you blast apart can be used and upgraded to cause chain reactions and destruction! Upgrades create interesting and over-the-top synergies that make runs chaotic and unique!
